label: Therapeutic effects of jaceosidin on atopic dermatitis via ubiquitin-mediated JAK1 degradation.
summary: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a prevalent inflammatory skin disease with substantial clinical burden. Jaceosidin (JAC), a trihydroxy-dimethoxy flavone primarily isolated from Artemisia genus and several other plants, possesses potent immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory activities with therapeutic potential for inflammatory skin diseases. However, its precise anti-AD mechanism remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic efficacy of JAC against AD and elucidate its underlying…
